text: Great! You can use your social security benefits without having to claim reimbursement yourself. I went for a filling; the rate is 800-1200 baht, but mine cost 1150 baht. The dentist was very quick.
I used my social security benefits for a free filling. Dr. Thippawan gave good advice and was gentle. The place was clean.
